snippet.title: Paper Shredder | Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4894750/Paper_Shredder

Shred your company's paperwork to earn a $1,000,000 payout. Paper Shredder is an incremental game where a sheet-after-sheet grind scales into mass document destruction. Shred, sweep, upgrade, and cut down tower-high piles of confidential records to uncover what’s buried beneath. Will you sign?
